title: Import Preview
summary: Previews a CSV or spreadsheet import, finds the real heading row and maps columns, so a bad file doesn't create junk records.
description: Import preview that finds the real heading row, maps columns by heading and by values with a confidence, holds the import while a required field is unmapped, and lists every skipped line with its line number and reason before a plain "Import 412 · skip 7".
catches: Title lines above the real headings, and headings about to be imported as a record
Columns matched by heading or by their values, with a confidence
Required fields left unmapped: import is held
Duplicates in the file and against existing records
Repeated headings and cells that fail a field's check
limits: Needs rows already parsed; it doesn't read CSV or XLSX itself
Value-based matching is a guess; check low-confidence columns
Duplicate check uses one key field, trimmed and case-insensitive
a11y: Each column mapping select has a label in a labelled list
Status and counts are in polite live regions; unmapped required fields use role=alert
server: Validate rows and enforce uniqueness constraints on the server during the import.
stops: Bad CSV import created junk records
